decisions.rationale: Queenly Majesty only blocks priority moves targeting its side; Talonflame's Tailwind targets our side, so Gale Wings bypasses it. T1: Tailwind (+1 prio) + Serperior Leaf Storm OHKOs Mega Swampert, threatens Basculegion. Sash protects Talonflame. Dragapult cleans up with Shadow Ball/Flamethrower; Incineroar cycles Intimidate to neuter physical Swift Swim sweepers.
decisions.notebook:
Key discovery: Queenly Majesty blocks only priority moves targeting Tsareena's side. Self/ally-side priority (Tailwind, Protect) bypasses it. Gale Wings Tailwind is safe vs Tsareena leads.

Rain mode: Mega Swampert Swift Swim 2x speed (160-224), Basculegion Scarf+Swift Swim 3x (321-429). Serperior Leaf Storm: guaranteed OHKO on Swampert-Mega, 86-156% on Basculegion. Talonflame Sash survives any hit. Dragapult speed-ties Scarf Basculegion outside rain; Shadow Ball 58-107% with Expert Belt.

Plan: lead Talonflame+Serperior for Tailwind+offense; back Dragapult+Incineroar for cleanup and Intimidate cycling. Remove Tsareena early to unlock Brave Bird priority. Watch for Raichu Fake Out disrupting Tailwind.

decisions.rationale: Lead Pelipper and Swampert with Basculegion and Archaludon in the back. Pelipper sets Drizzle for Swampert and Basculegion's Swift Swim. Swampert Mega Evolves and threatens the opponent's board, while Pelipper provides Tailwind or attacking pressure.
decisions.notebook: Bring Drizzle rain core with Pelipper, Mega Swampert, and Basculegion. Archaludon rounds out the offensive/defensive pressure.

decisions.rationale: Gale Wings Tailwind goes first, doubling our speed. Serperior Leaf Storm OHKOs Swampert (168-302%) before it can Mega Evolve and sweep. If Swampert Protects, we still secure Tailwind and Serperior loses nothing. Brave Bird on Pelipper only does 34-64%, not worth sacrificing Tailwind tempo. Taunt on Pelipper costs us our own speed control.

decisions.rationale: Talonflame threatens Tailwind or Brave Bird, and Serperior threatens Leaf Storm into Swampert. Pelipper uses Wide Guard to block potential spread moves / pressure while Swampert Protects + Mega Evolves to safely establish Swift Swim rain position.
decisions.notebook: Bring rain core. Pelipper and Mega Swampert handle aggressive leads with Wide Guard + Protect. Basculegion and Archaludon ready in back.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Swampert-Mega)
decisions.rationale: Serperior and Tailwind Talonflame outspeed us under Tailwind. Pelipper repeats Wide Guard to block potential Leaf Storm / spread or heavy pressure, while Swampert-Mega switches out to Basculegion to preserve matchup pressure and avoid getting dismantled by Leaf Storm.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper is Taunted and vulnerable to Serperior's Grass attacks in rain, but switching Swampert-Mega in safely preserves our rain core while Archaludon enters cleanly alongside to weather Talonflame and Serperior.
decisions.notebook: Pelipper and Mega Swampert lead rain core. Watch out for Serperior Contrary Leaf Storm + Life Orb under Tailwind. Archaludon in back handles switch-ins well.

decisions.rationale: Talonflame Protect avoids the double OHKO threat (both Pelipper Weather Ball and Archaludon Electro Shot OHKO through Sash if combined). Serperior Leaf Storm guaranteed OHKOs Pelipper, removing rain immediately. This neuters Archaludon's Electro Shot (becomes 2-turn charge) and denies Swift Swim to any future Swampert. Next turn we have 2v1 with +4 Serperior and full Talonflame under final Tailwind turn.
decisions.notebook: Rain mode: Mega Swampert Swift Swim 2x speed (180-244), Basculegion Scarf+Swift Swim 3x (321-429). Serperior Leaf Storm: guaranteed OHKO on Pelipper and Swampert-Mega, 86-156% on Basculegion. Talonflame Sash survives any single hit. Dragapult speed-ties Scarf Basculegion outside rain; Shadow Ball 58-107% with Expert Belt. Serperior +4 Dragon Pulse vs Archaludon: 68.5-133.3% (Sitrus Berry complicates). Dragapult Flamethrower into Archaludon is only neutral (Fire/Steel 2x × Dragon 0.5x = 1x), weak. Archaludon Draco Meteor 2HKO on Dragapult (95-217%). Plan: lead Talonflame+Serperior for Tailwind+offense; back Dragapult+Incineroar for cleanup and Intimidate cycling. Remove rain setter early to cripple Archaludon and Swampert.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper switches to Mega Swampert to gain Swift Swim speed and heavy physical offenses. Archaludon fires Electro Shot into foe Serperior (which boosts SpA and hits well), or hits Talonflame. Actually, let's use Electro Shot into Talonflame or Serperior. Electro Shot into Talonflame OHKOs with 2x effectiveness in rain. Wait, Talonflame is at slot 1, Serperior at slot 2. Let's check Talonflame speed: Talonflame moves first under Tailwind. Archaludon's Electro Shot charges on turn 3 and hits same turn, so it eliminates Talonflame or deals massive damage. Swampert outspeeds under rain.
decisions.notebook: Serperior Contrary Leaf Storm + Life Orb is dangerous under Tailwind (2 turns left). Mega Swampert and Archaludon form a strong core in rain.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Tailwind fails while already active (1 turn left), so refreshing is impossible. Serperior Leaf Storm OHKOs Pelipper guaranteed (178-352%) and hits +6 SpA. Talonflame Brave Bird chips Pelipper (34-64%) ensuring the KO even in edge cases. Archaludon likely KOs Serperior with Flash Cannon afterward, but that leaves a 3v1 with my full bench vs Archaludon alone—a dominant endgame regardless of Tailwind expiry.

Archaludon Flash Cannon guaranteed KO on 36% Serperior. Game 1 plan: lead Talonflame+Serperior for Tailwind+offense; eliminate rain setter early; back Dragapult+Incineroar for cleanup.

decisions.rationale: Dragapult (213) and Serperior (181) both outspeed Archaludon (105–137). Double-target with Shadow Ball (24–58%) + Dragon Pulse (92–177%) guarantees a KO before Archaludon moves, minimum 116% combined. Even if opponent Protects or Draco Meteors Dragapult, Serperior's Dragon Pulse alone has a high OHKO chance and Serperior still outspeeds next turn. Incineroar is too slow to contribute before Archaludon acts.

Serperior +6 Dragon Pulse vs Archaludon: 91.9–177%, possible OHKO through Sitrus Berry. Dragapult Shadow Ball vs Archaludon: 24.4–58.2%. Combined double-target always KOs before Archaludon moves.

decisions.rationale: Archaludon is at +2 SpA and can OHKO Dragapult with Draco Meteor. Since Pelipper has fainted, slot 1 passes. Draco Meteor guarantees a clean KO on Dragapult, eliminating the faster threat while Serperior is at 25% HP.
decisions.notebook: Pelipper and Archaludon core; Archaludon at +2 SpA is a massive offensive threat with Draco Meteor and Flash Cannon. Watch out for Serperior (Contrary + Leaf Storm + Life Orb) and remaining backend threats (Gardevoir, Appletun, Incineroar).

reflections.summary: Serperior's Contrary Leaf Storm rampaged unchecked after Talonflame's Taunt neutralised Pelipper's Wide Guard, OHKOing Basculegion, Swampert-Mega, and Pelipper before they could counterattack, while Dragapult helped finish Archaludon.
reflections.adjustment: Game 2: Lead Serperior + Dragapult to maintain pressure against potential Tsareena or Raichu, with Talonflame ready in the back to set Tailwind once the priority-blocking threat is removed.
reflections.notebook: Rain mode: Pelipper (Damp Rock, Wide Guard, Hydro Pump, Weather Ball, Tailwind), Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim, Earthquake, Liquidation, Ice Punch, Protect), Basculegion (Choice Scarf + Swift Swim 3x speed under rain; Last Respects, Wave Crash, Flip Turn, Phantom Force), Archaludon (Electro Shot in rain is one-turn with SpA boost; Flash Cannon, Draco Meteor, Protect, Sitrus Berry). Tsareena and Raichu are the remaining bench; likely brought in game 2. Pelipper's Wide Guard only blocks spread moves; Taunt on it denied future Wide Guard attempts. Serperior Leaf Storm OHKO's Pelipper, Swampert, Basculegion; Dragon Pulse at +6 can OHKO Archaludon through Sitrus Berry. Talonflame's Focus Sash broken by its own recoil. Archaludon Electro Shot does ~64% to Serperior (resisted) and OHKO's 84% Talonflame. Combined Dragapult Shadow Ball + at least +2 Serperior Dragon Pulse always KO's Archaludon under Tailwind. Plan for game 2: anticipate Tsareena or Raichu; lead Dragapult+Serperior, conserve Talonflame for late Tailwind; Incineroar can pivot and Fake Out Archaludon's Electro Shot if needed.

reflections.summary: The opponent's Serperior freely spammed Contrary Leaf Storm under Talonflame's Tailwind, compounding massive Special Attack boosts and cleaning up the rain sweepers before they could break through.
reflections.adjustment: Bring faster or more disruptive options (or prioritize double-targeting Serperior immediately) to prevent Contrary stat stacking from running away with the game.
reflections.notebook: Opponent runs Serperior (Contrary, Life Orb, Leaf Storm, Dragon Pulse, Protect, Glare) alongside Tailwind Talonflame. Watch out for rapid SpA escalation under Contrary.
